rv.q: But unfortunately, given the talent involved, this Adding Machine falls short of the sum of its parts.
An inspired cast of four actors now brings a thrilling revival of 'The Adding Machine' to the New Group.
Brecht’s Drums in the Night, O’Neill’s The Hairy Ape and Strindberg’s The Ghost Sonata are typical of this influential genre, which led to the extremely pliable dramaturgy of many plays today.
The Adding Machine offers a needed anti-AI screed for our times, but the machinery is deeply flawed and weighed down by faulty performances, uneven direction, and a dated script.
It is a strong, assured start for The New Group in its new home—one that anticipates a promising future.
